description_en: Detects and identifies products displayed on store shelves or floor stacks by combining a multimodal large language model (MLLM) with visual vector recall, targeting shelf and floor-stack inspection scenarios in offline retail and channel stores. The service first uses an MLLM to detect bounding boxes and preliminary names for each product in a store photo, then performs similarity recall against a customer-specific SKU vector library to exactly match each product to the customer's own SKUs, and outputs per-product structured results that can be directly integrated with business systems. This is suitable for large-scale, high-concurrency visual recognition pipelines such as remote auditing of in-store displays by headquarters, SKU distribution verification, and display compliance inspection
description_zh: 陈列检测是基于多模态大模型（MLLM）+ 视觉向量召回构建的门店商品陈列智能识别能力，面向线下零售 / 渠道门店的货架 / 地堆陈列巡检场景。产品对门店实拍的货架图、地堆图，先用多模态大模型检测出每个商品的边界框与初步名称，再以客户专属 SKU 向量库做相似度召回，把每个商品精确匹配到客户自有的 SKU，输出可直接对接业务系统的逐商品结构化结果。适用于总部对线下门店陈列的远程稽核、SKU 铺货核验、陈列合规巡检等大规模、高并发的视觉识别流水线
name: MerchandisePlacementDetection

parameters.help_en: The URL of the shelf or floor-stack image to be recognized (accessible via the public network or OSS)
parameters.help_zh: 待识别的货架 / 地堆原图 URL（公网或 OSS 可访问）
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The customer-specific SKU vector library ID that determines which library to retrieve from. The library must be created in advance through the library creation process
parameters.help_zh: 客户专属 SKU 向量库 ID，决定在哪一份库内召回；该库需先通过建库流程建好
parameters.name: rag_id

parameters.help_en: The business type (reserved for future routing by business line). The current release supports skincare & lotion
parameters.help_zh: 业务类型（预留，用于后续按业务线路由）；本期上线【水乳】
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: Specifies a custom API version. If you created a "My API" during the trial phase, you can find the corresponding ApiId in the product console under "Intelligent Inspection > API Management > My API"
parameters.help_zh: 如需指定自定义版本的 API 可传此参数：若在试用阶段创建过「我的 API」，可通过产品后台「智能巡检 - API 管理 - 我的 API」查询对应功能的 ApiId
parameters.name: api_id
